superseded_by.candidate: G43-MCLP-sup_oof (maximal covering on the supervised out-of-fold prior)
superseded_by.why_supersedes: The NO_GO above concerns G43-CG01, a different arm. This arm was scored on the SAME preregistered four-fold protocol (200-cell blocks, 3-px edge guard, 2-px training-trace guard, official 300-m triangular-kernel DTI), at EQUAL MASS 40,000 on the SAME allowed emission domain, against the reproduced H42 reference arm SH_basin_strong|sep4.0|N40000.

equal_mass_result.truth_scope: withheld published-catalogue faults; not hidden competition truth

superseded_by.measurement_caveat: CAUTION, and it is not a formality. An earlier comparison of the SHIPPED 51,053-dot full-grid layout against the same reference scored only 0.219994 and won 0/4 folds -- but it had only ~13.7k of its dots inside each fold's allowed domain against the reference's 40,000, so that was a mass artefact, not a result. The 0.286388 above is the same prior packed by the protocol's own greedy_pack at sep 3.0 / N 40,000. The shipped file is emitted by the maximal-covering solver with NO separation constraint and a Dinkelbach-derived budget, and that exact emission has NOT yet been scored at equal mass on this protocol. The prior is validated; the specific placement is not.

release.raster_novelty_audit: PASS (worst coverage IoU 0.181 vs 175 prior submissions)

superseded_by.next_step: Score the shipped maximal-covering emission itself at equal mass on this protocol (requires rebuilding the channel stack and the supervised out-of-fold surface, both of which live in the gitignored .cache/ and were lost). If it does not beat 0.250744, emit the sep3.0/N40000 packing of the same prior instead.

release.raster_novelty_audit: PASS (Jaccard ~0.011 vs 3 hash-verified priors; duplicate threshold 0.80)

decision.rationale: The SUP01 file is the only shipped layout whose exact emission family (sep-4.0 greedy packing, N=40,000) was scored at equal mass on the frozen protocol (0.262666 vs 0.250744, 4/4 folds; evidence/holdout_g43_mclp.json), and its build is reproducible from pinned inputs (scripts/build_submission_sup01.py). The MCLP file's prior is validated (0.286388 sep-3.0 packing; evidence/holdout_g43_cg01.json) but its shipped maximal-covering placement was never scored at equal mass (see superseded_by measurement_caveat), its channel stack and OOF surface were lost with .cache/, and an independent round-2 test of MCLP placement lost 0/4 folds (0.211122).
decision.next_step: Rebuild the supervised prior + validated sep-3.0/N40000 packing into a shippable file (the prior scores 0.286388 on the same protocol); score any MCLP emission at equal mass before promoting it. See research/review_log.md merge entry.
